name.zh-Hant: 格雷梅國家公園與卡帕多奇亞
name.zh-Hans: 格雷梅国家公园与卡帕多奇亚
name.en: Göreme and the Rock Sites of Cappadocia

airspace.zh: 土耳其的無人機由民航總局SHGM管理：依2026年7月的新規定，除了玩具以外都要登記（250公克以下也不例外），每次飛行都要核准，限白天、目視範圍內、120公尺以下；外國遊客通常須經使領館至少提前20天申請，並由土耳其籍遙控飛行員監督，入境時沒有SHGM的符合證明，無人機可能在機場被扣留。實際飛行前請先確認最新規定。
airspace.en: Türkiye's civil aviation directorate (SHGM) regulates drones: under the July 2026 rules every drone except toys must be registered (sub-250 g ones too), each flight needs approval, and flights are limited to daylight, line of sight and 120 m; foreign visitors usually apply through an embassy at least 20 days ahead and fly under a Turkish remote pilot, and without SHGM's letter of conformity a drone may be held at the airport. Check the current rules before any real flight.

uchisar.note: Town and 60 m castle rock, 1,270 m (38°37′44″N 34°48′12″E)

derinkuyu.note: Underground city, about 85 m deep (N 38°22.404 E 34°44.094)

tagline.zh-Hant: 四世紀的隱修者、藏在地下的城市、十一世紀的岩窟教堂，到1985年的世界遺產
tagline.en: Fourth-century hermits, cities hidden underground, 11th-century rock churches and World Heritage in 1985

zh: 這裡是土耳其中部的卡帕多奇亞，
格雷梅一帶的山谷，藏著上百座鑿在岩石裡的教堂。
en: This is Cappadocia in central Türkiye;
the valleys around Göreme hide many churches cut into the rock.

zh: 四世紀起，隱修者在這裡鑿洞而居；
他們遵循凱撒利亞主教、大巴西略的教導。
en: From the 4th century hermits carved homes here,
following the teachings of Basil the Great, Bishop of Caesarea.

zh: 大巴西略生於329年；
凱撒利亞，就是今天的開塞利。
en: Basil the Great was born in 329;
Caesarea is the modern city of Kayseri.

zh: 七到十三世紀，
格雷梅是重要的基督教中心。
en: Between the 7th and 13th centuries
Göreme was an important Christian centre.

zh: 蘋果教堂大約建於1050年，
黑暗教堂建於十一世紀末到十二世紀初。
en: The Apple Church was built around 1050,
the Dark Church in the late 11th and early 12th centuries.

zh: 黑暗教堂一直到1950年代還被當成鴿舍，
後來花了十四年才修復完成。
en: The Dark Church was used as a dovecote until the 1950s,
and its restoration took fourteen years.

zh: 往南約三十公里，是代林庫尤地下城，
它最早可能由弗里吉亞人在西元前八到七世紀開鑿。
en: Some 30 km south lies the underground city of Derinkuyu,
perhaps first dug by the Phrygians in the 8th–7th centuries BC.

zh: 拜占庭時代，為了躲避阿拉伯人的侵襲，
地下城被擴建完成，最深約八十五公尺。
en: In Byzantine times, as shelter from Arab raids,
it was completed, reaching about 85 metres deep.

zh: 它最多可容納兩萬人和牲畜，
每一層，都能用滾動的大石門從裡面封住。
en: It could hold up to 20,000 people with their animals,
and each floor could be sealed from inside with rolling stone doors.

zh: 1923年，希臘與土耳其交換人口，
卡帕多奇亞的希臘人離開，地下城也就荒廢了。
en: In 1923, with the population exchange between Greece and Türkiye,
Cappadocia's Greeks left and the tunnels were abandoned.

zh: 1963年，一位居民整修房子時，
在牆後發現了一個密室，地下城才重見天日。
en: In 1963 a resident renovating his house
found a hidden room behind a wall, and the city came to light again.

zh: 1969年，代林庫尤開放參觀；
它和凱馬克勒地下城之間，有八到九公里的地道。
en: Derinkuyu opened to visitors in 1969;
some 8 to 9 km of tunnels linked it to Kaymaklı.

zh: 烏奇沙的岩石城堡，
最早出現在十四世紀的一部編年史裡。
en: The castle rock of Uçhisar
is first mentioned in a 14th-century chronicle.

zh: 1985年，「格雷梅國家公園與卡帕多奇亞岩石遺址」
同時以文化與自然價值，列入世界遺產。
en: In 1985 Göreme National Park and the Rock Sites of Cappadocia
became World Heritage, for both cultural and natural values.

zh: 從隱修者的洞穴到地下的城市，
這片軟岩，收藏了將近兩千年的人類歷史。
en: From hermits' caves to cities underground,
this soft rock holds almost two thousand years of human history.

tagline.zh-Hant: 鴿舍與鴿糞肥料、紅河邊的陶藝、清晨的熱氣球，與每年數百萬的遊客
tagline.en: Dovecotes and pigeon manure, pottery by the Red River, dawn balloons and millions of visitors

zh: 烏奇沙城堡是一座高約六十公尺的岩石，
過去可能住過大約一千人。
en: Uçhisar castle is a rock about 60 metres high;
perhaps a thousand people once lived inside it.

zh: 小鎮海拔一千兩百七十公尺，
2022年約有三千五百人。
en: The town stands at 1,270 metres
and had about 3,500 people in 2022.

zh: 山谷兩側，鑿出了許多鴿舍；
鴿糞一直到1970年代，都被拿來當肥料。
en: Many dovecotes were carved into the valley sides;
pigeon droppings were used as fertiliser into the 1970s.

zh: 從烏奇沙走鴿子谷到格雷梅，
大約要兩個小時。
en: The walk through Pigeon Valley from Uçhisar to Göreme
takes about two hours.

zh: 格雷梅露天博物館，大約有十幾座教堂，
是這一帶參觀人數最多的地方。
en: The Göreme Open Air Museum holds about a dozen churches
and is the most visited place in the area.

zh: 每年來卡帕多奇亞的遊客，估計有兩百萬到四百萬人；
研究認為，博物館在多數月份都超過了承載量。
en: Some 2 to 4 million people visit Cappadocia each year;
a study found the museum over its carrying capacity in most months.

zh: 北邊的阿瓦諾斯，在土耳其最長的河流克孜勒河畔，
「克孜勒」的意思，是「紅色」。
en: To the north, Avanos lies on the Kızılırmak, the longest river in Türkiye;
its name means "Red River".

zh: 阿瓦諾斯最重要的產業是陶藝，
用的是河裡紅色淤泥的黏土，可能從西臺時代就開始了。
en: Pottery is Avanos's main trade,
using clay from the river's red silt; it probably goes back to Hittite times.

zh: 古代它叫做維內薩，
2022年，小鎮約有一萬五千人。
en: In antiquity it was called Venessa;
in 2022 the town had about 15,000 people.

zh: 卡帕多奇亞也是熱氣球旅遊的重鎮；
2024年，土耳其的熱氣球乘客達九十三萬多人次。
en: Cappadocia is also a centre of balloon tourism;
in 2024 Türkiye counted over 933,000 balloon passengers.

zh: 那一年全國飛了四萬三千多趟，
由七十一家業者、四百四十一顆熱氣球載客。
en: That year saw more than 43,000 flights,
by 71 companies with 441 balloons.

zh: 卡帕多奇亞是熱氣球旅遊成長的主力，
也帶動了土耳其自己製造、出口熱氣球。
en: Cappadocia has led the growth of balloon tourism,
and Türkiye now builds balloons and exports them.

zh: 越野四輪車的導覽，也帶來壓力，
估計每天約有四百輛，在這一帶來回。
en: ATV tours add pressure too:
an estimated 400 vehicles a day run through the area.

zh: 2019年，這裡和兩座地下城一起，
劃入約八萬六千公頃的「卡帕多奇亞區」管理。
en: In 2019 the area and two underground cities
became part of the Cappadocia Area, about 86,000 hectares.

zh: 鴿舍、陶窯與清晨的熱氣球，
人們一直在這片軟岩上找生活的方法。
en: Dovecotes, potters' kilns and balloons at dawn:
people have always found ways to live on this soft rock.

tagline.zh-Hant: 年雨量三百八十公釐的高原、六百多種植物、河谷裡的綠帶，與脆弱的軟岩
tagline.en: A plateau with 380 mm of rain, some 650 plants, green ribbons in the valleys and fragile soft rock

zh: 卡帕多奇亞的高原很乾，
每年雨量只有大約三百八十公釐。
en: The Cappadocian plateau is dry,
with only about 380 mm of rain a year.

zh: 除了河谷沿岸，
這裡的植被都很稀疏。
en: Apart from the river corridors
there is little vegetation here.

zh: 格雷梅丘陵一帶，記錄到約六百五十種植物，
其中一百一十八種，是土耳其特有種。
en: About 650 plant taxa are recorded in the Göreme hills,
118 of them found only in Türkiye.

zh: 這裡也有二十三種全國罕見的植物，
新的特有種，還不斷被發現。
en: There are 23 plants rare in the whole country,
and new endemic species are still being found.

zh: 山谷兩側的鴿舍，
收集鴿糞，給田地當肥料。
en: The dovecotes on the valley sides
collected pigeon droppings to fertilise the fields.

zh: 克孜勒河是土耳其最長的河，
河邊的綠色河谷，在乾燥的高原上特別顯眼。
en: The Kızılırmak, the longest river in Türkiye,
runs through a green corridor that stands out on the dry plateau.

zh: 河水帶來的紅色淤泥，
給了阿瓦諾斯的陶匠黏土。
en: The red silt carried by the river
gives the potters of Avanos their clay.

zh: 越來越多的遊客、車輛與建築，
是這片土地最大的壓力。
en: More and more visitors, vehicles and buildings
are the greatest pressure on this land.

zh: 大約八百棟違建已經拆除，
還有將近一千件案子等待處理。
en: About 800 illegal buildings have been removed,
with nearly a thousand more cases pending.

zh: 灌溉用的水壩，讓空氣變得更潮濕，
也加快了軟岩的風化。
en: Irrigation dams have made the air more humid,
speeding the weathering of the soft rock.

zh: 精靈煙囪目前只有大約三到三成五，
完成了調查與編目。
en: Only about 30 to 35 per cent of the fairy chimneys
have been surveyed and catalogued so far.

zh: 2025年，世界自然保護聯盟的評估，
把這裡的保護前景列為「令人高度關切」。
en: In 2025 IUCN's assessment
rated the outlook for the site as "significant concern".

zh: 不過，同一份評估也指出，
這裡其他的生物多樣性價值「良好」，而且正在「改善」。
en: Yet the same assessment rates its other biodiversity values
as "good" and "improving".

zh: 往南的代林庫尤，地下有一條深五十五公尺的通風井，
它也兼作取水的水井。
en: To the south, Derinkuyu has a ventilation shaft 55 metres deep
that also served as a well.

zh: 乾燥的高原、稀有的植物與脆弱的岩石，
需要更小心的照顧。
en: A dry plateau, rare plants and fragile rock
all need more careful looking after.

title.en: A Land Carved from Volcanic Ash

tagline.zh-Hant: 千萬年前的火山灰、九層熔結凝灰岩、風與水雕出的精靈煙囪
tagline.en: Volcanic ash ten million years old, nine ignimbrite layers, and fairy chimneys carved by wind and water

zh: 卡帕多奇亞是一片海拔約一千公尺的高原，
由凝灰岩構成，上面覆蓋著熔岩。
en: Cappadocia is a plateau about 1,000 metres high,
made of tuff and covered with lava.

zh: 凝灰岩是火山灰凝固而成的細粒岩石，
和埃爾吉耶斯山與哈桑山的火山活動有關。
en: Tuff is a fine-grained rock of consolidated volcanic ash,
linked to the volcanoes of Mount Erciyes and Mount Hasan.

zh: 一千萬到五百萬年前的中新世，
大型火山口噴出的火山碎屑流，一層層堆積。
en: Between 10 and 5 million years ago, in the Miocene,
flows of volcanic debris from great calderas piled up layer on layer.

zh: 地質學家辨識出九層熔結凝灰岩，
總厚度超過四百三十公尺。
en: Geologists have identified nine ignimbrites,
together more than 430 metres thick.

zh: 這些火山口如今已經被埋在地下，
整個火山區，長約三百公里，寬二十到五十公里。
en: Those calderas are now buried;
the whole volcanic province is about 300 km long and 20 to 50 km wide.

zh: 地殼抬升之後，水與風開始侵蝕軟岩，
刻出懸崖、岩塔、帳篷岩與精靈煙囪。
en: After uplift, water and wind began to wear the soft rock,
carving cliffs, rock towers, tent rocks and fairy chimneys.

zh: 有些精靈煙囪頂著一塊熔岩，
堅硬的岩帽，保護了底下較軟的凝灰岩。
en: Some fairy chimneys wear a cap of lava,
a hard top that shields the softer tuff below.

zh: 精靈煙囪能不能形成，
要看岩層的厚度、熔結的程度與坡度。
en: Whether fairy chimneys form
depends on the thickness of the layers, how welded they are, and the slope.

zh: 烏奇沙海拔一千兩百七十公尺，
從城堡岩上，可以俯瞰周圍的山谷。
en: Uçhisar stands at 1,270 metres;
from its castle rock you look out over the surrounding valleys.

zh: 軟岩容易開鑿，
小鎮中心有一條在凝灰岩裡挖出的地道，長約一百公尺。
en: The soft rock is easy to dig;
a tunnel about 100 metres long runs through the tuff under the town centre.

zh: 克孜勒河古代叫做哈利斯河，
它切過高原，從阿瓦諾斯旁流過。
en: The Kızılırmak, the ancient Halys,
cuts across the plateau past Avanos.

zh: 阿瓦諾斯位在海拔九百二十公尺，
比烏奇沙低了三百多公尺。
en: Avanos lies at 920 metres,
more than 300 metres lower than Uçhisar.

zh: 代林庫尤的地下城，
在凝灰岩裡往下挖了大約八十五公尺。
en: The underground city of Derinkuyu
was dug about 85 metres down into the tuff.

zh: 地震、地層下陷與乾旱，
也是這片軟岩地景面對的風險。
en: Earthquakes, sinkholes and drought
are further risks for this landscape of soft rock.

zh: 火山灰堆成的高原，被水與風慢慢雕刻，
直到今天，雕刻還沒有停止。
en: A plateau of volcanic ash, slowly carved by water and wind;
the carving has not stopped yet.
